source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: test_saveAs.js removes CR characters from both actual and expected text only in its .txt and .html checks. The .eml check retains the original substrings. A generated body without any line ending had hidden the mismatch on Unix; adding a realistic CRLF body exposed it. Keep this assertion tolerance scoped to platform-formatted export. It does not establish byte-for-byte serialization correctness or justify stripping newlines from production messages. No export test or native platform comparison ran.
title: Text and HTML export tests tolerate platform line endings
